allow: PowerShell(where.exe java 2>$null; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10 Name)

PowerShell($f = Get-Command ffmpeg.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($f\) { $f.Source } else { "ffmpeg: not found" }; $p = Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "python: " + $p.Source } else { "python: not found" }; $py = Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($py\) { "py: " + $py.Source } else { "py: not found" })
